name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-07-14, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.32 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
